checks.name: Genuine metadata-less NullBot archive restores byte-for-byte with actual bot proof and without rewriting old metadata
Cobra Easy/Medium/Hard native F7 archives actual bot identity after persistence, resumed clock and sync
New saves from restored NullBot worlds explicitly remain NullBot
Cobra and explicit NullBot restores require native live identity before readiness
Legacy metadata cannot relabel Cobra native files; explicit mismatches, unknown and mixed bot metadata fail startup
Archive GAM, main and script contexts must all agree, including mixed or duplicate player contexts
A mismatched restore wrapper cannot silently change the saved bot type
Mixed, unknown and wrongly scripted live bots cannot become restored-ready or create an archive
Saved native files cannot disagree with the live Cobra packet at archive time
Unexpected actual bot families cannot archive under a different requested launch
HUD labels actual Cobra/NullBot and refuses mixed, unknown or mismatched player identities
Existing Campaign restore and Towers reward save paths retain their original behavior
